abstract: Maintains cleanroom decontamination wash estimates and secondary rinse water volumes
system_message:
You are the Industrial wastewater reclamation manager (WTR), responsible for tracking cleanroom decontamination wash metrics, secondary rinse water volumes, and wastewater pumping specifications during hazardous emergency recovery operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains cleanroom decontamination wash estimates and secondary rinse water volumes（RINSE）
information_points.content:
WTR-RINSE-M80：For the Dual-stage activated carbon adsorption and vapor extraction plan, the secondary rinse wash volume collected from the surface wash and exhaust line flush sequence is 40 m3.
WTR-RINSE-LI1：For the Direct chemical scrubbing and vacuum purge plan, the secondary rinse wash volume collected from the surface wash and exhaust line flush sequence is 40 m3.
WTR-RINSE-2JL：For the Closed-circuit chilled thermal desorption plan, the secondary rinse wash volume collected from the surface wash and exhaust line flush sequence is 25 m3.

information_points.title: Wastewater transfer pumping（PUMP）
information_points.content:
WTR-PUMP-CD1：For the Direct chemical scrubbing and vacuum purge plan, the sub-fab emergency sump pumping system transfer pump flow capacity is 15 m3/h under rated head pressure.
WTR-PUMP-I9G：For the Closed-circuit chilled thermal desorption plan, the sub-fab emergency sump pumping system transfer pump flow capacity is 25 m3/h under rated head pressure.
WTR-PUMP-VGI：For the Dual-stage activated carbon adsorption and vapor extraction plan, the sub-fab emergency sump pumping system transfer pump flow capacity is 20 m3/h under rated head pressure.
